BlockedHolding.name: Blocked Holding
BlockedHolding.definition: Specifies how the blocked account holding is defined.

PartialHoldingUnits.name: Partial Holding Units
PartialHoldingUnits.definition: When an account is blocked at the level of fund or security, partially, this is the number of units blocked.

HoldingCertificateNumber.name: Holding Certificate Number
HoldingCertificateNumber.definition: When an account is blocked at the level of fund or security, this specifies the certificate number of the blocked units.

PartialHoldingUnits1Rule.definition: If BlockHolding is NPRH (NonPartialHolding) then PartialHoldingUnits must not be present.

PartialHoldingUnits2Rule.definition: If BlockHolding is PRTH (PartialHolding) then PartialHoldingUnits is mandatory.

PartialHoldingUnits3Rule.definition: If BlockHolding is CERT (Certificate) then PartialHoldingUnits must not be present.

HoldingCertificateNumberRule.definition: If BlockHolding is CERT (Certificate) then HoldingCertificateNumber is mandatory.
